summary: Aider is a terminal AI pair-programming harness written in Python (package `aider-chat`, console entrypoint `aider = aider.main:main`). It edits files in the current working directory (using git for its repo map and change tracking) and makes every LLM call through litellm: `aider/llm.py` lazy-loads litellm and `Model.send_completion` in `aider/models.py` calls `litellm.completion` with the model name, streaming flag and optional tool spec. Using an `openai/<name>` model makes litellm's OpenAI chat-completions client honour `OPENAI_API_BASE`/`OPENAI_BASE_URL`, so all requests (main, weak and editor models) go to `$PROXY_URL/v1/chat/completions`. A single non-interactive task is run with `--message "$TASK"` plus `--yes-always`, which answers every confirmation, applies the edits and exits after one turn; chat and full LLM request/response history files are written under /out.
dockerfile:
ARG BASE=python:3.12-slim-bookworm
FROM ${BASE}

# System deps aider needs at run time (git for GitPython / repo map). Does not touch the base's python/node.
RUN apt-get update \
 && apt-get install --no-install-recommends -y ca-certificates curl git \
 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Self-contained Python runtime + venv under /opt/harness via uv
ENV UV_INSTALL_DIR=/opt/harness/uv \
    UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR=/opt/harness/python \
    UV_CACHE_DIR=/opt/harness/uv-cache \
    UV_LINK_MODE=copy
RUN mkdir -p /opt/harness/bin \
 && curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh \
 && /opt/harness/uv/uv python install 3.12 \
 && /opt/harness/uv/uv venv --python 3.12 /opt/harness/venv

# Install aider from the repo source (build context = repo root)
COPY . /opt/harness/src
# setuptools_scm needs a version when .git is not in the build context
ENV SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION=0.86.3
RUN /opt/harness/uv/uv pip install --python /opt/harness/venv/bin/python --no-cache /opt/harness/src \
 && rm -rf /opt/harness/uv-cache

# Expose only the harness CLI on PATH. The console script has an absolute shebang to the venv
# python, so a symlink is fine. harness-python must be a wrapper, NOT a symlink: CPython looks for
# pyvenv.cfg next to the *unresolved* argv0, so a symlink in /opt/harness/bin would run the base
# interpreter without the venv's site-packages.
RUN ln -sf /opt/harness/venv/bin/aider /opt/harness/bin/aider \
 && printf '#!/bin/sh\nexec /opt/harness/venv/bin/python "$@"\n' > /opt/harness/bin/harness-python \
 && chmod +x /opt/harness/bin/harness-python

ENV PATH=/opt/harness/bin:$PATH
RUN mkdir -p /out && chmod 777 /out
check_command: aider --version && aider --help >/dev/null && harness-python -c "import aider, litellm; print(aider.__version__)"
notes: Fix vs previous recipe: the check failed at `harness-python -c "import aider"` because harness-python was a symlink into the venv. CPython resolves pyvenv.cfg relative to the unresolved argv0 directory (/opt/harness/bin), found none, and fell back to the base interpreter under /opt/harness/python, which has no aider installed. harness-python is now a tiny sh wrapper that execs /opt/harness/venv/bin/python directly. `aider` stays a symlink because console scripts have an absolute shebang to the venv python (that is why `aider --version` already worked). PATH now only prepends /opt/harness/bin so the base image's python3/pip3 are not shadowed. Model choice: `openai/gpt-4o` is in aider's model-settings (diff edit format, repo map on) and the `openai/` prefix routes litellm to the OpenAI chat-completions client using OPENAI_API_BASE, so the proxy sees plain /v1/chat/completions; weak and editor models are pinned to the same name so nothing escapes to another provider. AIDER_* env vars are read via configargparse (auto_env_var_prefix="AIDER_"). `--yes-always` answers all confirm prompts (stdin is not a tty), including creating a git repo in the task dir if none exists so the repo map works; `--no-auto-commits --no-dirty-commits --no-gitignore` keep aider from committing or editing .gitignore; `--no-suggest-shell-commands` prevents auto-running LLM-suggested shell commands; `--no-auto-lint` skips flake8 follow-up turns. `--no-check-update` and `--analytics-disable` remove pypi/posthog network use; LITELLM_LOCAL_MODEL_COST_MAP=True stops litellm fetching its cost map from GitHub. Aider's own ModelInfoManager tries to fetch litellm's model_prices JSON from GitHub once per 24h into ~/.aider/caches; the failure without network is caught and only affects context-window/cost display. HOME=/tmp gives a writable ~/.aider. `--no-stream` is only for cleaner non-tty logs; streaming works through the proxy. Trajectory: /out/aider.llm.history (full LLM request/response log) and /out/aider.chat.history.md. SETUPTOOLS_SCM_PRETEND_VERSION is needed because .git may be absent from the build context (.dockerignore).
